t.Colonne vertébrale émotionnelle du réper: The emotional backbone of the repertoire: from 18 March 1997, the day of the haemorrhagic stroke when life hung by a thread, to waking from the coma on 1 April, then the patient recovery of walking, speech and the joy of fatherhood.

t.Bertrand Charpilloz est un auteur-compos: Bertrand Charpilloz is a French singer-songwriter and lyricist, born on 20 January 1966 in Saverne, Alsace. He presents a repertoire of 21 original songs in French and the piano and voice recital L'Altesse Ego with pianist Marie-Françoise Coelho.
t.Quel style de musique fait-il ?: What kind of music does he make?
t.De la chanson française à texte, entre p: French literary chanson, between intimate spoken-sung delivery and cabaret blues, carried by a deep baritone voice. His references are Serge Gainsbourg, Alain Bashung, Benjamin Biolay and Alain Souchon.
t.Écrit-il ses propres chansons ?: Does he write his own songs?
t.Oui. Bertrand Charpilloz signe les parol: Yes. Bertrand Charpilloz writes the lyrics and music of all 21 songs in his catalogue.

t.Quelle différence entre « L'Altesse Ego: What is the difference between « L'Altesse Ego » and « Mon Altesse Ego »?
t.« L'Altesse Ego » est le nom du récital: « L'Altesse Ego » is the name of the piano and voice recital. « Mon Altesse Ego » is a song from the repertoire, written as a tribute to pianist Marie-Françoise Coelho.
t.Quel est le lien entre sa musique et son: How is his music linked to his stroke?
t.Victime d'un AVC hémorragique en 1997, i: After a haemorrhagic stroke in 1997, he told the story of his recovery in the book « Mes liaisons cérébrales » (2013) and then in the song « Le Fil Rouge ».

t.Né le 20 janvier 1966 à Saverne, d'un pè: Born on 20 January 1966 in Saverne, Alsace, to a Swiss father and a mother from Martinique, Bertrand Charpilloz grew up with the accordion and an early love of melody and rhythm. He first built a career as a management consultant.
t.Deux épreuves vont tout déplacer. Le 20: Two ordeals changed everything. On 20 January 1992, his 26th birthday, his elder sister Dominique died in the Mont Sainte-Odile air crash. On 18 March 1997, a haemorrhagic stroke left him in a coma. He woke up paralysed on one side and unable to speak, and spent three years learning to walk and talk again, partly by singing. He tells the story of this recovery in
t.De ces années, il a tiré une philosophie: From those years he drew a simple philosophy: keep things in perspective, let go, choose love over despair and poetry over chaos. « Rien n'est jamais perdu » (nothing is ever lost), reads the subtitle of his book. His 21 original songs carry that conviction: lyrics without artifice, between puns, portraits of women, places and meditations on time, in the tradition of Serge Gainsbourg, Alain Bashung, Benjamin Biolay and Alain Souchon.
He has devoted himself to music since 2009. With pianist Marie-Françoise Coelho, he now takes these songs on stage for everyone looking for something to hold on to: you can lose the thread, and tie it again.
t.Quelle philosophie portent ses chansons: What philosophy do his songs carry?
t.Une philosophie née de l'épreuve : relat: A philosophy born of hardship: keep things in perspective, let go, choose love over despair and poetry over chaos. The subtitle of his book sums it up: « Rien n'est jamais perdu. L'important est de ne jamais désespérer. » (Nothing is ever lost. What matters is never to despair.)

t.Pianiste et chanteuse de formation, Mari: Trained as a pianist and singer, Marie-Françoise Coelho entered the conservatoire at 6 and won a first prize in piano and music theory at 16. She then turned to theatre, with the Théâtre Jeune Public in Strasbourg and at street-theatre festivals.
t.À partir de 1999, elle se consacre au tr: Since 1999 she has focused on voice work. As a dubbing and voice-over actress, she lends her voice to documentaries and reports, notably for Arte, to programme idents and to audiobooks, including Virginie Grimaldi's « Le premier jour du reste de ma vie » (Frémeaux & Associés) and the children's book « Garance et le maître des couleurs ».
t.Dans « L'Altesse Ego », elle ne se conte: In « L'Altesse Ego » she does more than accompany: she sings some passages of the recital as a duet and takes on the role of storyteller. « Mon Altesse Ego » is dedicated to her.
t.Marie-Françoise Coelho est la pianiste d: Marie-Françoise Coelho is the pianist of the « L'Altesse Ego » recital, where she also sings some passages as a duet and takes on the role of storyteller. Trained as a pianist and singer (first prize in piano and music theory at 16), she has also been a dubbing and voice-over actress since 1999: documentaries, notably for Arte, and audiobooks, including Virginie Grimaldi's « Le premier jour du reste de ma vie ».
t.La traversée de l'épreuve, l'adieu, la s: Crossing the ordeal, farewells, urban solitude, passing time and the gratitude of being alive.
t.Jeux de langue, humanisme tempéré et fab: Wordplay, tempered humanism and a sharp fable.
